name: NoorPDP
author: noorealam

sections.description:
NoorPDP lets you redesign the WooCommerce single product page without touching a theme file:

  • Product Title, Rating, Price, Short Description, Add to Cart, Meta, Gallery, Tabs and Breadcrumbs blocks — each a thin wrapper around WooCommerce’s own woocommerce_template_single_*() functions, so variations, stock handling and reviews keep working exactly as WooCommerce implements them
  • Product Grid and Related Products blocks for latest/related/upsell product listings
  • Container, Heading, Button, Accordion and Tabs layout blocks for arranging everything
  • Product Layouts — full page arrangements built in the standard block editor, so it works on any theme, not just block themes
  • Assign a Layout per product, per product category, or as the site-wide default; unconfigured products keep rendering exactly as vanilla WooCommerce always has
  • An editor Template Library with premade full layouts and drop-in sections (FAQ accordion, trust badges, feature table)

Everything above is free — no license, upsell, or locked feature anywhere in the plugin.

External services

This plugin includes an optional “Cloud Templates” source that can fetch additional premade templates from a remote API. It is disabled by default and only activates if a site or another plugin explicitly defines the NOORPDP_CLOUD_URL constant (or hooks the noorpdp/cloud_api_url filter) with a real endpoint URL — out of the box, this plugin makes no external requests at all.

When enabled, the plugin sends a single GET request to the configured URL (no personal or site-identifying data included beyond standard HTTP headers) to retrieve a JSON list of templates, and caches the response in a transient for 12 hours.

Source Code

The JavaScript in the build/ directory is compiled from the human-readable source in src/. Full source, including the build tooling, is available at https://github.com/noorealamdev/noorpdp. To regenerate the compiled files:

npm install && npm run build
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/noorpdp.
  3. Run npm install && npm run build inside the plugin directory (development installs only).
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  5. Go to Products → Add New Product Layout, build a layout, then assign it to a product from the “Product Page Template” box on the product edit screen.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release: WooCommerce product blocks, Product Layouts, per-product/category/site-wide template assignment, starter layouts and sections.

noorpdp/product-meta.name: noorpdp/product-meta
noorpdp/product-meta.title: Product Meta
noorpdp/product-meta.description: Displays the current WooCommerce product's SKU, categories and tags.

noorpdp/tabs.name: noorpdp/tabs
noorpdp/tabs.title: Tabs
noorpdp/tabs.description: Organize content into switchable tabs. Powered by the WordPress Interactivity API with full keyboard support.

noorpdp/feature-cards.name: noorpdp/feature-cards
noorpdp/feature-cards.title: Feature Cards
noorpdp/feature-cards.description: A row or grid of cards, each with a heading and a line of supporting text — useful for ingredients, benefits, or feature highlights.

default.heading: Elderberry Extract
default.text: Strengthens your first line of defense against seasonal threats.

default.heading: Echinacea Purpurea
default.text: Activates natural immune response for faster recovery.

default.heading: Crystalline Ginger
default.text: Relieves internal inflammation and supports respiratory health.

noorpdp/product-gallery-carousel.name: noorpdp/product-gallery-carousel
noorpdp/product-gallery-carousel.title: Product Gallery Carousel
noorpdp/product-gallery-carousel.description: A swipeable carousel of the current WooCommerce product's own images, with an optional thumbnail strip.

noorpdp/comparison-table.name: noorpdp/comparison-table
noorpdp/comparison-table.title: Comparison Table
noorpdp/comparison-table.description: A feature-by-feature comparison table, useful for plans, variants, size guides or specs.

noorpdp/hero.name: noorpdp/hero
noorpdp/hero.title: Hero
noorpdp/hero.description: A full-width hero section with a heading, subheading, call-to-action button and an optional background image or video.

noorpdp/product-grid.name: noorpdp/product-grid
noorpdp/product-grid.title: Product Grid
noorpdp/product-grid.description: Display a responsive grid of WooCommerce products (latest, related, upsells or cross-sells), rendered dynamically so it always stays up to date.

noorpdp/product-reviews.name: noorpdp/product-reviews
noorpdp/product-reviews.title: Product Reviews
noorpdp/product-reviews.description: A rating summary with a star breakdown and a responsive grid of the current WooCommerce product's reviews, rendered dynamically so it always stays up to date.

noorpdp/product-title.name: noorpdp/product-title
noorpdp/product-title.title: Product Title
noorpdp/product-title.description: Displays the current WooCommerce product's title.

noorpdp/product-category.name: noorpdp/product-category
noorpdp/product-category.title: Product Category
noorpdp/product-category.description: Displays the current WooCommerce product's category as a small label — useful right above the Product Title.

noorpdp/urgency.name: noorpdp/urgency
noorpdp/urgency.title: Urgency & Countdown
noorpdp/urgency.description: A low-stock warning or countdown timer (sale end date or a custom deadline) that nudges shoppers toward buying now.

stockMessage.default: Only {stock} left in stock — order soon!

noorpdp/sticky-add-to-cart.name: noorpdp/sticky-add-to-cart
noorpdp/sticky-add-to-cart.title: Sticky Add to Cart Bar
noorpdp/sticky-add-to-cart.description: A bar fixed to the bottom of the screen with the product thumbnail, name, price and a Buy Now button — appears once the visitor scrolls past the main Add to Cart block.

noorpdp/product-specifications.name: noorpdp/product-specifications
noorpdp/product-specifications.title: Product Specifications
noorpdp/product-specifications.description: Displays the current WooCommerce product's attributes as a specification table, the same data shown in the native Additional Information tab.

noorpdp/icon-list.name: noorpdp/icon-list
noorpdp/icon-list.title: Icon List
noorpdp/icon-list.description: A list of short lines, each with a picked icon instead of a bullet — e.g. shipping info, trust points, feature highlights.

default.text: Estimated Delivery : Up to 4 business days
Free Shipping and Returns : On all orders over $200

noorpdp/review-carousel.name: noorpdp/review-carousel
noorpdp/review-carousel.title: Review Carousel
noorpdp/review-carousel.description: A curated, swipeable carousel of hand-picked reviews for a chosen product.

noorpdp/product-price.name: noorpdp/product-price
noorpdp/product-price.title: Product Price
noorpdp/product-price.description: Displays the current WooCommerce product's price.

noorpdp/faq.name: noorpdp/faq
noorpdp/faq.title: FAQ Accordion
noorpdp/faq.description: A collapsible list of frequently asked questions about the product.

noorpdp/product-rating.name: noorpdp/product-rating
noorpdp/product-rating.title: Product Rating
noorpdp/product-rating.description: Displays the current WooCommerce product's star rating.

noorpdp/product-tabs.name: noorpdp/product-tabs
noorpdp/product-tabs.title: Product Tabs
noorpdp/product-tabs.description: Displays the current WooCommerce product's description, additional information and reviews tabs.

noorpdp/button.name: noorpdp/button
noorpdp/button.title: Advanced Button
noorpdp/button.description: A customizable call-to-action button with link, colors and typography options.

noorpdp/container.name: noorpdp/container
noorpdp/container.title: Container
noorpdp/container.description: A flexible wrapper section for grouping and laying out other blocks.

noorpdp/accordion.name: noorpdp/accordion
noorpdp/accordion.title: Accordion
noorpdp/accordion.description: Collapsible content panels, perfect for FAQs. Powered by the WordPress Interactivity API — no jQuery, minimal footprint.

noorpdp/trust-badges.name: noorpdp/trust-badges
noorpdp/trust-badges.title: Trust Badges
noorpdp/trust-badges.description: A row of icon + label badges (e.g. Third-Party Tested, Vegan Friendly) in a soft rounded card, divided by vertical lines.

noorpdp/product-breadcrumbs.name: noorpdp/product-breadcrumbs
noorpdp/product-breadcrumbs.title: Product Breadcrumbs
noorpdp/product-breadcrumbs.description: Displays the WooCommerce breadcrumb trail for the current product.

noorpdp/product-short-description.name: noorpdp/product-short-description
noorpdp/product-short-description.title: Product Short Description
noorpdp/product-short-description.description: Displays the current WooCommerce product's short description (excerpt).

noorpdp/related-products.name: noorpdp/related-products
noorpdp/related-products.title: Related Products
noorpdp/related-products.description: Displays WooCommerce's related products for the current product.

noorpdp/product-add-to-cart.name: noorpdp/product-add-to-cart
noorpdp/product-add-to-cart.title: Product Add to Cart
noorpdp/product-add-to-cart.description: Displays the WooCommerce add-to-cart form for the current product, including variations, quantity and stock handling.

noorpdp/heading.name: noorpdp/heading
noorpdp/heading.title: Advanced Heading
noorpdp/heading.description: A heading block with adjustable level, alignment, colors and typography.

noorpdp/tab.name: noorpdp/tab
noorpdp/tab.title: Tab
noorpdp/tab.description: A single tab panel inside a Tabs block.

noorpdp/accordion-item.name: noorpdp/accordion-item
noorpdp/accordion-item.title: Accordion Item
noorpdp/accordion-item.description: A single collapsible panel inside an Accordion.
